hint_ladder: Acknowledge what was just said, then add a contrasting point.
The whole phrase is fixed and comes first in its sentence.
Start with the words: The plan is cheap. ___ said that, it will take months.
teaching_content.reveal_form: The plan is cheap. Having said that, it will take months.
canonical_forms: The plan is cheap. Having said that, it will take months.
alternative_realizations: Having said that, the plan is still the best one we have.
